objective.name: sandbox.py.bad_run
objective.description: Interpreted wrapper-backed capacity used to prove run failure fail-closed behavior

#root.role: Select an interpreted wrapper configuration that fails during run and expose the fail-closed execution path.

effects.wrapper_runtime: The interpreted wrapper run path is exercised and expected to fail closed.

transformation_contract.morphing: An interpreted execution request becomes a fail-closed runtime error path when the selected wrapper cannot start correctly.
invariants: sandbox.py.bad_run must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.py.bad_run returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.py.bad_run fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
